headline: Insurance Companies Must Know! OJK Sets Minimum Solvency Limit at 120%
summary: The financial services regulator OJK issued new rules setting a minimum solvency ratio of 120% for insurance companies. The aim is to strengthen risk management and financial resilience.
why: Solvency requirements determine how much capital insurers must hold, which affects their earnings, dividends and balance sheet strength.
original_headline: Bos Asuransi Wajib Tahu! OJK Tetapkan Batas Solvabilitas Minimal 120%
